en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large, castle-like administrative residence with crenellated rooflines and a tall corner tower. The multi-storey building faces a curved street where a horse-drawn carriage and a few pedestrians are visible, suggesting an early 20th-century urban setting. Printed captions in Swedish and Finnish appear at the top, identifying the building and location.
